# `/convert-entitlement-connection` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /convert-entitlement-connection/v1

`startEntitlementConnectionConversionV1` — Convert entitlement connection assignment type — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Initiates an asynchronous workflow to convert the assignment type of an entitlement connection between `STANDING` and `JIT` (Just-In-Time Privileged). The response is returned with HTTP 202 Accepted while the conversion workflow initializes.

- Scopes: idn:jit-assignment-type-conversion:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): convertentitlementconnectionrequest
- Returns 202: convertentitlementconnectionresponse
